rblxbuild_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(RblxGizmo LANGUAGES CXX)

set(RBLXBUILD_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(RBLXBUILD_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(RBLXBUILD_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    set(RBLXGIZMO_STANDALONE TRUE)
else()
    set(RBLXGIZMO_STANDALONE FALSE)
endif()

option(RBLXGIZMO_BUILD_EXAMPLE "Build the example application" ${RBLXGIZMO_STANDALONE})

add_library(rblxgizmo STATIC
    src/RblxGizmo.cpp
    src/GraphEditor.cpp
    src/RblxCurveEdit.cpp
    src/RblxGradient.cpp
    src/RblxSequencer.cpp
    src/RblxVectorEditor.cpp
)

add_library(rblxgizmo::rblxgizmo ALIAS rblxgizmo)

target_include_directories(rblxgizmo PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${RBLXBUILD_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

if(RBLXGIZMO_BUILD_EXAMPLE)
    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(
        rblxui
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ocornut/rblxui.git
        GIT_TAG master
        GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(rblxui)
    add_library(rblxui STATIC
        ${rblxui_SOURCE_DIR}/rblxui.cpp
        ${rblxui_SOURCE_DIR}/rblxui_draw.cpp
        ${rblxui_SOURCE_DIR}/rblxui_tables.cpp
        ${rblxui_SOURCE_DIR}/rblxui_widgets.cpp
        ${rblxui_SOURCE_DIR}/rblxui_demo.cpp
    )
    target_include_directories(rblxui PUBLIC ${rblxui_SOURCE_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(rblxgizmo PUBLIC rblxui)
endif()

if(RBLXGIZMO_BUILD_EXAMPLE)
    add_subdirectory(example)
endif()
